amiya.en_intro: Amiya is the young leader of Rhodes Island, wielding powerful Arts and personally stepping onto the front lines. In this build she is a high-growth, high-cost caster leader—capable of burst damage while driving overall tempo through Support cards. Her command of Arts and Resonance makes her stronger as a fight unfolds.
amiya.en_mechanic:
Signature Mechanic: Will
Will is Amiya's exclusive resource (cap 10). Several cards build Will, and the more Will she has, the stronger her advanced Arts become—finishers and burst spells scale directly with it.
But high Will carries pressure: some cards spend it, and overload-style lines can cause self-damage or tempo loss. In short, Will is the system that turns Amiya's burden into combat power.

amiya.zh_intro: 阿米娅是罗德岛的年轻领袖，擅长强力术式，并会亲自奔赴前线解决问题。在这套构筑中，她是高成长、高代价的术师领袖——既能打出爆发伤害，也能通过支援牌带动全局节奏。作为领袖，她对术式与共振的驾驭让她在战局中越打越强。
amiya.zh_mechanic:
特有机制：意志
意志是阿米娅的专属资源（上限 10）。部分卡牌会积累意志，意志越高，她的高阶术式就越强——终结牌和爆发牌都会随意志提升伤害。
但意志并非越高越好：它代表精神负荷与承担的代价。部分牌会消耗意志，某些过载打法还会带来自伤或节奏风险。简单来说，意志就是阿米娅把「责任」转化为力量的核心系统。
amiya.zh_stats: 生命 72/72    起始能量 4    核心资源：意志

exusiai.en_intro: Exusiai opens with a lighter, faster deck built around chained plays, multi-hit attacks, and energy refunds. She does not tank through fights; she races ahead of enemy tempo instead. As a courier of Penguin Logistics, she prefers to solve problems with overwhelming firepower.
exusiai.en_mechanic:
Signature Mechanic: Ammo / Burst
Ammo is Exusiai's exclusive resource (cap 6); Shot cards typically cost Ammo. When depleted, she must reload via specific cards or wait for turn start.
Passive "Angel of Bullets": the first Ammo spent each turn grants +1 Shot damage this turn; in Burst mode, also draw 1 card.
Burst: certain cards trigger Burst state, boosting Shot damage, granting bonus energy and draws—her core damage window.
exusiai.en_stats: HP 70/70    Starting Energy 3    Core Resource: Ammo (cap 6)    Core Focus: Multi-hit Tempo
exusiai.zh_header: 能天使 | 快速火力投射
exusiai.zh_intro: 能天使的首发卡组更轻、更快，重点是连续打牌、多段命中和返还能量。她不靠厚防线，而是把战斗节奏压快，争取在敌人起势前把场面打穿。作为企鹅物流的快递员，她习惯用密集火力解决一切问题。
exusiai.zh_mechanic:
特有机制：弹药 / 爆发
弹药是能天使的专属资源（上限 6），射击牌通常需要消耗弹药。弹药耗尽时，她需要通过装填牌或等待回合开始来补给。
被动「子弹天使」：每回合第一次消耗弹药时，本回合射击牌伤害 +1；若处于爆发状态，额外抽 1 张牌。
爆发机制：部分卡牌会触发「爆发」状态，爆发期间射击牌伤害提升、能天使获得额外能量与抽牌，是她的核心爆发窗口。
exusiai.zh_stats: 生命 70/70    起始能量 3    核心资源：弹药（上限 6）    核心倾向：多段速攻

kaltsit.en_intro: Kal'tsit relies on neither rapid volleys nor single Arts bursts. She enters combat with Mon3tr, sustains herself through Medical cards, repairs Mon3tr, and uses Commands to break enemy lines. As Rhodes Island's medical director, every move she makes is calm, precise, and controlled.
kaltsit.en_mechanic:
Signature System: Mon3tr Integrity / Command: Meltdown
Mon3tr starts each combat at 3/10 Integrity; from Kal'tsit's second turn onward, it auto-repairs 1 per turn. Below 2 Integrity, Mon3tr cannot fight.
At max Integrity, Command: Meltdown activates: Mon3tr's max Integrity rises to 15, Kal'tsit attacks and Mon3tr damage gain +50%, and Mon3tr ignores enemy Block. Meltdown ends when Integrity drops to 2 or below, and max Integrity returns to 10.
kaltsit.en_stats:
HP 72/72    Starting Energy 4    Draw 4 per turn
Core Resource: Mon3tr Integrity (cap 10)    Core Focus: Medical Repair / Mon3tr Command
kaltsit.zh_header: 凯尔希 | Mon3tr 医疗指令
kaltsit.zh_intro: 凯尔希不靠高速连射，也不靠单次术式爆发。她会在战斗开始时带着 Mon3tr 入场，用医疗牌维持自己，用修复牌维持 Mon3tr，再用指令牌让 Mon3tr 撕开敌人的防线。作为罗德岛的医疗主管，她的每一步都冷静、精确、可控。
kaltsit.zh_mechanic:
特有机制：Mon3tr 完整性 / 指令：融毁
Mon3tr 战斗开始时为 3/10 完整性；从第二个凯尔希回合开始，每回合自动修复 1 点。完整性低于 2 时，Mon3tr 将无法参战。
当完整性达到上限时进入「指令：融毁」：Mon3tr 最大完整性提升至 15，凯尔希攻击与 Mon3tr 伤害 +50%，且 Mon3tr 伤害无视敌方护盾。当完整性降至 2 以下时退出融毁，最大完整性回到 10。
kaltsit.zh_stats:
生命 72/72    起始能量 4    每回合抽牌 4
核心资源：Mon3tr 完整性（上限 10）    核心倾向：医疗修复 / Mon3tr 指令

nearl.en_intro: Nearl does not win through flashy bursts. She stabilizes fights with Block, healing, and Support cards until the battlefield bends back in her favor. Her starter deck is sturdier and more methodical. As the Radiant Knight of Kazimierz, her frontline rarely collapses.
nearl.en_mechanic:
Signature Mechanic: Will / Radiant Guard
Nearl also uses the Will resource (cap 10), but hers primarily gates defensive and Support cards.
Passive "Radiant Guard": the first card each turn with a Block effect gains 4 extra Block. This lets her hold the line without sacrificing tempo, dragging tough enemies into favorable turns.
nearl.en_stats: HP 80/80    Starting Energy 4    Core Resource: Will    Core Focus: Defense Support
nearl.zh_intro: 临光不靠花哨的爆发，而是用稳定护盾、治疗与支援牌把局面慢慢拉回自己这边。她的起始牌组更厚、更稳，适合把一场仗打成可控的消耗战。作为卡西米尔的耀骑士，她的防线几乎不会轻易崩塌。
nearl.zh_mechanic:
特有机制：意志 / 耀骑士守势
临光同样使用意志资源（上限 10），但她的意志更多用于防御与支援牌的触发条件。
被动「耀骑士守势」：每回合第一张打出且带有护盾效果的牌，额外获得 4 点护盾。这让她能在不牺牲节奏的前提下稳住战线，把强敌拖进对自己有利的回合。
nearl.zh_stats: 生命 80/80    起始能量 4    核心资源：意志    核心倾向：防御支援

amiya_command_room.en_body:
The office at the end of the corridor is still lit. A tactical map sits pressed under a sheet of glass, its red-marked evacuation line already revised three times.

Amiya stands at the desk and listens through the reports from each squad. Some need Support, some need more decisive orders, and some only want to know whether the next step is still worth waiting for.
amiya_command_room.zh_body:
楼道尽头的办公室还亮着灯。战术地图被压在玻璃板下，红笔标出的撤离线已经被改过三次。

阿米娅站在桌边听完各队汇报。有人需要支援，有人需要命令更果断，也有人只想知道下一步到底还能不能等。

amiya_memory_fragment.en_body:
A glowing memory storage chip lies fallen in the ruins, the Rhodes Island emblem on its face already worn.

Amiya recognizes it — an archive from an early operation. Inside may be precious tactical data, or old images she would rather not face.
amiya_memory_fragment.zh_body:
废墟里掉落着一块发光的记忆存储芯片，表面的罗德岛标志已经磨损。

阿米娅认出了它——这是早期行动的存档。里面可能是珍贵的战术数据，也可能是她不愿面对的旧日影像。

amiya_resonance_triage.en_body:
Inside the medical tent, the Originium readings climb at the same instant. The breathing of the wounded, the distant explosions, and the faint glow in Amiya’s palm almost form a single line.

The medical operator does not rush her, only passes over the clipboard: stabilize the wounded first, or turn this anomalous reading into preparation for the next battle.
amiya_resonance_triage.zh_body:
医疗帐篷里，源石读数在同一刻抬高。伤员的呼吸、远处的爆炸声和阿米娅掌心的微光几乎连成一条线。

医疗干员没有催促，只把记录板递过来：先稳定伤员，还是把这次异常读数转成下一场作战的准备。

collapsed_shelter.en_body:
A corner of an underground shelter’s ceiling has caved in during the aftershocks. Faint cries for help come through the dust.

People are trapped inside. Getting them out will take time and tools, and may leave the squad injured. But left alone, they will suffocate within hours.
collapsed_shelter.zh_body:
一个地下避难所的顶板在余震中塌了一角。灰尘里传来微弱的呼救声。

里面有人被困住了。救出来需要时间和工具，也可能让队伍受伤。但放任不管，这些人会在几小时内窒息。

dobermann_inspection.en_body:
The squad had barely caught its breath when Dobermann called a halt, saying she wanted a look at your current build. The way she shuffled through the cards was no different from inspecting a poorly maintained weapon; the longer she looked, the tighter her brow became.

In her eyes, hesitation is dead weight, and a lack of decisiveness is a discipline problem. She does not care whether a card looks "gentle"; she only cares whether this build will hold up when the situation finally collapses. Amiya did not talk back, but the words clearly did not land lightly.

Dobermann lays the way out bluntly. Either cut the soft parts and tighten the deck. Or go fiercer outright, instead of always trying to cover both ends. Or else say nothing more, and keep walking forward with this bit of discomfort in tow.
dobermann_inspection.zh_body:
队伍刚喘口气，杜宾就把人叫停了，说要看看你现在这套构筑。她翻牌的表情，跟检查一把保养没做好的武器差不多，越看眉头越紧。

在她眼里，犹豫就是拖后腿，不够果断就是纪律出问题。她不在乎一张牌看起来是不是「温和」，她只在乎真到局面崩的时候，这套东西顶不顶得住。阿米娅没顶嘴，但那话听着显然不轻。

杜宾把路说得很直白。要么砍掉软的，牌组收紧一点。要么干脆更凶一点，别老想着两头都顾。再不然，就别说了，带着这点不舒服继续往前走。

exusiai_delivery_detour.en_body:
A delivery slip softened by rain is pasted to a signpost, its address falling right behind the fire zone. Exusai scans the number and confirms it is no ordinary cargo.

Inside the crate may be supplies — or trouble. Worse, the client has written: please be on time.
exusiai_delivery_detour.zh_body:
一张被雨水泡软的派送单贴在路牌上，收件地址正好落在交火区背后。能天使扫了一眼编号，确认那不是普通货物。

箱子里可能是补给，也可能是麻烦。更糟的是，委托人写着：请务必准时。

exusiai_rooftop_cover.en_body:
A makeshift ladder leads to a row of low rooftops. The Reunion forces across the street have not spotted this angle yet, though their patrol rhythm is growing denser.

Exusai sets up her firearm and asks easily: break their rhythm now, or save this position for when it is truly needed?
exusiai_rooftop_cover.zh_body:
临时梯架通向一排低楼屋顶。街对面的整合运动还没发现这个角度，只是巡逻节奏越来越密。

能天使架好铳，问得很轻松：要现在打乱他们，还是把这个位置留到真正需要的时候。

kaltsit_briefing.en_body:
Before the next deployment, Kal'tsit sends over an updated briefing. She speaks as she always does, as flat as if reading a medical record, but her meaning is clear: this district is growing harder and harder to predict, and charging ahead with your eyes closed will likely cost you far more down the line.

She does not decide for Amiya either; she only lays out a few paths. If you want steadier ground, first get a clear read on the route intelligence. If you want to even out the tempo, take the calmer approach. And if you are willing to eat a loss in the here and now, you can trade it for a rarer, more specialized Support line.

Kal'tsit does not need to make her words heavy. She only has to set the facts down, and the pressure settles onto you on its own.
kaltsit_briefing.zh_body:
下一轮部署前，凯尔希把更新过的简报送来了。她说话还是老样子，平得像在念病历，可意思很清楚: 这片城区现在越来越难猜了，闭着眼往前冲，后面多半要吃更大的亏。

她也没替阿米娅拍板，只是把几条路摆出来。想稳一点，就先把路线情报摸清。想把节奏放平，就走更冷静的打法。要是愿意吃点眼前的亏，也能换一条更稀有、更专门的支援线。

凯尔希不用把话说得很重。她只要把事实摆那儿，剩下的压力自然就落到你们头上了。

kaltsit_field_triage.en_body:
The field medical point is set up in a half-collapsed station. Kal'tsit flips through two case records and strikes out one unnecessary procedure on the spot.

There is little time, and even less medicine. She offers no one comfort; she simply lays the plans for survival on the table.
kaltsit_field_triage.zh_body:
临时医疗点设在塌了一半的车站里。凯尔希翻过两份病历，直接划掉了其中一项不必要的处理流程。

时间不多，药更少。她没有安慰任何人，只把能活下来的方案摆在桌面上。

kaltsit_mon3tr_diagnostics.en_body:
An abandoned exam room still holds a monitor that can boot. Once the screen lights up, Mon3tr’s readings flood the entire pane of glass within seconds.

Kal'tsit studies the curves and offers three plans: Repair, restraint, or letting it operate at an even more dangerous edge.
kaltsit_mon3tr_diagnostics.zh_body:
废弃诊疗室还留着一台能启动的监测仪。屏幕亮起后，Mon3tr 的读数在数秒内铺满整面玻璃。

凯尔希看完曲线，给出三个方案：修复、约束，或允许它在更危险的边缘作战。

kaltsit_research_note.en_body:
On a scattered research note, Kal'tsit recognizes her own handwriting — early deductions on Mon3tr’s stability.

At the end of the note sits an unfinished formula: complete it, and Mon3tr’s combat capability may be strengthened; destroy it, and it never falls into another’s hands.
kaltsit_research_note.zh_body:
一张散落的研究笔记上，凯尔希认出了自己的笔迹。是关于 Mon3tr 稳定性的早期推演。

笔记末尾写着一个未完成的公式——如果补全，可能强化 Mon3tr 的作战能力；如果销毁，则避免它落入他人之手。

nearl_evacuation_line.en_body:
The crowd is pinned behind a temporary barricade, the explosions behind them drawing ever nearer. Nearl does not hurry them along; she only plants her shield between the squad and the mouth of the street.

This line can be held, or pushed. The difference lies in who takes the first shock.
nearl_evacuation_line.zh_body:
人群被堵在临时路障前，后方的爆炸声越来越近。临光没有催他们快走，只把盾立在队伍和街口之间。

这条线可以守，也可以推进。区别在于，谁先承担第一轮冲击。

nearl_knightly_oath.en_body:
Faded tournament posters still cling to the wall, touting victory, honor, and a pile of pretty words no one has believed for a long time.

Nearl stops and lays her hand on the rim of her shield. She does not stop for the words on the poster, but to confirm what she means to guard next.
nearl_knightly_oath.zh_body:
墙面上还贴着褪色的竞技海报，写着胜利、荣誉和一堆早就没人相信的漂亮话。

临光停下脚步，把手按在盾缘。她不是为了海报里的词停下，而是为了确认自己接下来要守住什么。

nearl_oath_stone.en_body:
Half-buried in the rubble is a stone tablet carved with a knightly oath, its lettering blackened by smoke but still legible.

Blemish stops in her tracks. This is a kind of echo of the oath she once swore — about guarding, about duty, about when to set down the shield and take up the sword.
nearl_oath_stone.zh_body:
半埋在瓦砾中的是一块刻有骑士誓言的石碑，字迹被烟熏黑但依然可辨。

瑕光停下脚步。这是她曾立誓的某种回响——关于守护、关于责任、关于何时该放下盾牌拿起剑。

nearl_principle.en_body:
Nearl stops in front of a collapsed checkpoint. The trapped people are behind a bent guardrail and an overturned car. Judging by efficiency alone, the easiest course right now is obviously to push on and finish the mission first.

But Nearl does not accept this. She says it calmly, yet her meaning is unmistakable: if Rhodes Island simply refuses to save people because it is too troublesome or too costly, it will eventually lose far more important things along with them. Her voice is not loud, but every word presses down with weight.

Amiya knows at once that no one here is truly in the wrong, and that is what makes it hardest of all. Standing with Nearl means trading Health and tempo. Prioritizing the mission makes actions cleaner, but also colder. A compromise sounds clever, yet it really just pushes the bill further down the road.
nearl_principle.zh_body:
临光在一处塌掉的检查口前停了下来。被困的人就在歪掉的护栏和翻倒的车后面。要是只看效率，现在最省事的做法当然是继续推进，先把任务做完再说。

可临光不认这个。她说得很平静，但意思一点都不含糊: 如果罗德岛因为救人太麻烦、太费代价，就干脆不救，那迟早会把更重要的东西也一起丢掉。她声音不大，可每个字都压得很实。

阿米娅一听就知道，这事没有谁是真错的，这才最难办。站临光这边，就得拿血量和节奏去换。优先任务，行动会更利索，但也会更冷。折中听着聪明，其实只是把账先往后压。

old_terminal_log.en_body:
A terminal that still boots flickers in the corner, its screen scrolling fragmentary logs.

This is the record left behind by some evacuated squad. The last few lines mention a hidden supply cache and an unknown tactical protocol. You can attempt to decode it, read it directly, or cut the power to avoid revealing your position.
old_terminal_log.zh_body:
一台还能启动的终端在角落里闪烁，屏幕上滚动着断断续续的日志。

这是某个撤离小队留下的记录。最后几行提到了一处隐藏的物资点和一种未知的战术协议。你可以尝试解码，也可以直接读取，或者切断电源避免暴露位置。

originium_cache.en_body:
A faint blue glow seeps from behind the wall — the outcrop of an unmined Originium vein.

Originium is a double-edged sword: it can strengthen Arts, but excessive exposure accelerates infection. You can harvest it recklessly, extract it in a stable manner, or seal the site to avoid the risk.
originium_cache.zh_body:
墙后透出淡淡的蓝色光晕——一处未被开采的源石矿脉露头。

源石是双刃剑：它能强化术式，但接触过量会加速感染。你可以冒险采集，可以用稳定的方式提取，也可以封锁现场避免风险。

ruined_supply_convoy.en_body:
A supply convoy was ambushed at the street corner, its carts overturned and cargo strewn everywhere.

You can see intact ammo crates and medical packs, but the engine is still smoking and could ignite at any moment. Greed will exact a price; caution may let a fine opportunity slip.
ruined_supply_convoy.zh_body:
一支补给车队在街道拐角被伏击，车厢翻倒，物资散落一地。

你能看见未损坏的弹药箱和医疗包，但引擎还在冒烟，随时可能引爆。贪婪会付出代价，谨慎则可能错失良机。

temporary_ward.en_body:
This place used to look like a small shop, now hastily tidied into a ward. Torn curtains hang from crooked shelves, and the light is too dim, leaving every face pale. Vials of medicine sit in rows on wooden crates, but no amount of tidying will make more of them appear.

Among the lying-down are civilians just dragged back from the riots, and Rhodes Island operators still itching to return to the front lines. Amiya listens to the medical report, yet her eyes keep drifting outside. She knows all too well that the next trouble may come at any moment, and what you have on hand cannot save everyone.

It is up to you now. Spend some money to shore up the ward, and you might keep a few more people alive tonight. Splitting it evenly sounds fair, but no one gets a sufficient amount. If you leave all the medicine for the front lines, the next battle will be a little easier, but the quiet left behind in this place will not pass so quickly either.
temporary_ward.zh_body:
这地方原本像是个小店，现在临时收拾成了病房。破帘子挂在歪掉的货架上，灯也不够亮，照得人脸色都发白。药剂一支支摆在木箱上，可再摆整齐也不会凭空多出来。

躺着的人里有刚从骚乱里拖回来的平民，也有还惦记着想站回前线的罗德岛干员。阿米娅听着医疗汇报，目光却老往街外飘。她心里很清楚，下一场麻烦随时会来，可你们手上的东西，救不了所有人。

现在就看你怎么选了。花点钱把病房先稳住，今晚大概能多留下几个人。平均分，听起来公平，但谁都拿不到足够的量。要是把药全留给前线，那下一场会轻松些，可这地方留下来的安静，也不会那么快过去。

wandering_merchant.en_body:
A merchant in a worn raincoat has pitched his tent among the ruins, a few dust-covered goods hanging from it.

"This isn't stolen," he says. "It's off the dead. The dead have no need of these things; the living do. Fair prices, no cheating young or old — but I don't take IOUs."
wandering_merchant.zh_body:
一个披着破旧雨衣的游商在废墟间支起帐篷，挂着几件蒙尘的货物。

"这不是偷的，"他说，"是从死人身上捡的。死人不需要这些东西，活人需要。价格公道，童叟无欺——但我不收欠条。"

ws_broadcast.en_body:
The radio suddenly bursts into a crackle, and once the static dies down, out comes that frown-inducing laugh of W. She is nearby — or she just wants you to think she is. Either way, she thoroughly enjoys turning the battlefield into her own stage.

This broadcast is not mere provocation. It also carries route fragments, explosion triggers, and half-true, half-false bait, clearly meant to lure you into a rhythm she has already prepared. Amiya says nothing, and the rest of the squad waits too, watching to see whether you chase it down, pick apart the intelligence, or simply decline to take her up on it.

Not everything W says can be believed, but none of it is entirely useless. Chasing the signal means walking into the very danger she wants. Slowly picking apart the pattern may make her harder to read later. Turning and walking away saves trouble for now, but you might also let something far more valuable slip away with it.
ws_broadcast.zh_body:
无线电突然炸了一下，刺啦刺啦响完，W 那种让人想皱眉的笑声就冒出来了。她在附近，或者她就是想让你觉得她在附近。反正她挺喜欢把战场搞成她自己的表演场。

这段广播不只是单纯挑衅。里头还夹着路线碎片、爆炸触发、半真半假的诱饵，摆明了是在勾你踩进她准备好的节奏里。阿米娅没说话，队里其他人也都在等，看你是准备追过去、拆情报，还是干脆不接她这茬。

W 说的话不能全信，但也不是一句都没用。追信号，就是往她想要的危险里走。慢慢拆模式，也许能让她之后没那么难猜。直接转身走人，眼前是省事了，可说不定也把什么更值钱的东西一起放跑了。

exusiai_event_result_text.The purification takes some time. Your c: 净化流程花了些时间。状态恢复了，侦测器也安静下来，只是那份额外收益也被一起清掉了。
exusiai_event_result_text.The rear supply line is re-secured. The: 后方补给线被重新固定。队伍恢复了一些状态，下一份奖励也会因为补给稳定而更丰厚。
exusiai_event_result_text.The record that only clouds your judgmen: 那段只会干扰判断的记录被删掉。牌组少了一点噪声，手牌也会更干净。
exusiai_event_result_text.The residual reaction is forced into you: 残余反应被强行转进战斗序列。身体吃了一点亏，但下一场能用的战斗手段也更多了。
exusiai_event_result_text.The risk is too high; you take the long: 风险太高，你选择绕行。队伍保持完整状态，继续向下一个节点推进。
exusiai_event_result_text.The route intelligence is written into t: 路线情报被写进地图。前面仍然危险，但你至少能提前看见两处节点。
exusiai_event_result_text.The shard is sealed in a lead box. It ca: 碎片被封进铅盒。它能当作模块核心使用，也会把一张灼烧的麻烦一起带进牌组。
exusiai_event_result_text.The signal is split into two executable: 信号被拆成两段可执行的战斗节奏。它们加入牌组，之后会直接影响出牌顺序。
exusiai_event_result_text.The signalman reallocates the frequencie: 通讯员重新分配频段，最危险的一条街区先收到了回应。前线没有欢呼，只是把下一次交火拖进了可控范围。
exusiai_event_result_text.The split teams keep their mobility, and: 分队保持了机动，侦察视野也被拉开。地图上会额外显示几个可预览节点。
exusiai_event_result_text.The squad adjusts its tempo per the brie: 小队按简报调整节奏。它不会替你赢下战斗，但能让下一次开局少一点慌乱。
exusiai_event_result_text.The squad declines her invitation. The e: 小队没有接她的邀请。撤离很顺利，只是那串坐标被你划掉时，所有人都知道里面可能藏着东西。
exusiai_event_result_text.The squad doesn't stop. The dead channel: 小队没有停留。断掉的频道被留在身后，下一层的情报也因此少了一截。
exusiai_event_result_text.The squad goes around the fissure, leavi: 小队绕开裂缝，从旁边的巷子离开。少拿了东西，但也少带了一份污染风险。
小队花时间做了心理整理。那张拖慢决断的干扰牌被移出牌组。
exusiai_event_result_text.The squad splits in two and barely holds: 小队拆成两组，勉强把两边都拖住了。没人能说这是最好的答案，但至少不是最坏的。
exusiai_event_result_text.The squad splits into two groups acting: 队伍拆成两组同时行动。两边都没崩，但你的队伍先付了这份压力。
无菌束带被收进随身装备。它不会立刻止痛，但之后的治疗会更稳。
exusiai_event_result_text.The support plans are resequenced. A new: 支援方案被重新排过顺序。新的指令牌加入牌组，方便你把后续行动接起来。
exusiai_event_result_text.The survivors come out trembling. The sq: 人被拖出来时还在发抖。小队受了伤，推进也慢了，但没有人需要假装没听见那几声呼救。
exusiai_event_result_text.The tactical network is written into the: 战术网络被写进终端。它不会替你做决定，但能让之后的出牌顺序更容易接上。
exusiai_event_result_text.The tactics team reconstructs most of th: 战术组还原出大半张部署图。下一场战斗开局会更清楚，不必等敌人先动手才反应。
exusiai_event_result_text.The terminal is half-repaired and hung i: 终端被修好一半，作为模块挂进系统。它旧是旧，但还能替你多看一段路。
exusiai_event_result_text.The training is unsparing, but the probl: 训练很不客气，但问题确实少了。牌组薄了一点，下一次抽到关键牌的机会也更高。
exusiai_event_result_text.The treatment order is rearranged: banda: 处理顺序被重新排好，止血和镇痛先落到还要上前线的人身上。没人喜欢这个决定，但它有效。
exusiai_event_result_text.The wandering merchant digs an operation: 游商从箱底翻出一张作战指令，字迹模糊但思路清晰。"这个能让你打得更狠一点。"
exusiai_event_result_text.The wounds are treated quickly and the s: 伤口被迅速处理，队伍状态回升。箱子里能立刻用的药也基本见底了。
exusiai_event_result_text.With professional tools you carefully ex: 你用专业工具小心翼翼地提取表层矿化物。没有受伤，还换到了一笔可观的报酬和一次休整。
exusiai_event_result_text.With the front-line kits taken, the squa: 前线包拿走后，小队的下一场准备充足了。病房没有抱怨，只是帘子后面安静得太快。
exusiai_event_result_text.With the portable array plugged into the: 便携阵列接上终端后，支援信号稳定了不少。它占地方，但确实能减少之后的断连。
exusiai_event_result_text.With the spare parts installed, the chan: 备用件换上后，频道重新接通。地图仍不完整，但至少不会再把整条街都糊成噪点。
exusiai_event_result_text.You accept the slower deployment plan in: 你接受了较慢的部署方案，换来更精准的支援路线。凯尔希只点了一下头，表示记录已更新。
exusiai_event_result_text.You approve a more aggressive push. The: 你批准了更激进的推进。敌人会被惊动，下一场更硬；但如果赢下来，回报也会翻倍。
exusiai_event_result_text.You chip out several high-purity origini: 你徒手敲下几块高纯度源石。皮肤传来灼烧感，但获得了一枚强化术式的模块。
exusiai_event_result_text.You copy the scheduling methods from the: 你把旧记录里的调度方式抄进终端。之后的战术轮换会顺手得多。
exusiai_event_result_text.You cut the ignition line and the engine: 你切断了点火线路，引擎熄火。物资不多，但拿到了一个能用的信号增幅器。
exusiai_event_result_text.You dig through the rubble with bare han: 你们徒手挖开了碎石。被困的人被抬出来时已经奄奄一息，但他们活着。有人塞给你一袋金币作为答谢。隐藏路线的进度被推进了。
exusiai_event_result_text.You don't linger over the letter; you st: 你没有继续停留在信上，而是先把活着的人稳住。治疗完成了，物资也少了一笔。
exusiai_event_result_text.You follow the signal and walk straight: 你顺着信号追过去，果然撞上伏击。队伍带回了能用的东西，也带回了一身爆炸余波。
exusiai_event_result_text.You move most of the cargo before the bl: 你抢在爆炸前搬走了大部分物资。一枚弹片擦伤了手臂，但金币和补给都到手了。
exusiai_event_result_text.You note the coordinates and notify the: 你记下坐标，通知了后方的救援队。队伍继续前进，但这次选择会在心里留下犹豫。一张迟疑牌加入了牌组。
exusiai_event_result_text.You press your emotions into the next op: 你把情绪压进下一场行动，开局资源会更充足。那些没处理完的噪声也被一起带进牌组。
exusiai_event_result_text.You pull the terminal's power. Your posi: 你拔掉了终端的电源。位置没有暴露，下一场战斗的开局会更平稳。
exusiai_event_result_text.You seal the entrance so the enemy can't: 你封住了入口，防止矿脉被敌人利用。路过时顺手捡了些散落的物资。下一场敌人会因为你的谨慎准备而变弱。
exusiai_event_result_text.You select several high-pressure combat: 你选出几段高压作战记录。它们被整理成新的牌，适合把资源转成爆发。
exusiai_event_result_text.You skip the encrypted section and read: 你跳过加密段，只看了明文部分。找到了一些物资坐标和一条能优化现有卡组的战术建议。
exusiai_event_result_text.You skip the new equipment and save the: 你没有立刻拿新装备，而是把升级名额留给支援链。后续整备时，这条线会被优先处理。
exusiai_event_result_text.You spend twenty minutes cracking the en: 你花了二十分钟破译加密段。日志提到一种罗德岛战术控制台协议，你成功复现了它。
exusiai_event_result_text.You stop saying you're fine. Once the pr: 你没有再说没事。压力被承认以后，终于能被整理成可用的行动方案。
exusiai_event_result_text.You trade a small cache of supplies for: 你们用一小笔物资换来更好的瞄具。能天使没有立刻开火，只把准星停在最该被记住的位置。

broken_comms.en_body:
The comms channel cuts in and out, and several nodes on the map have turned to static. Exusai taps her headset and confirms it is not broken equipment — the signals in this area are simply too scrambled.

Repairing the channel will cost money, and forcing a push forward leaves uncertainty; you can also boost the signal temporarily so the next stretch of Support connects faster.
broken_comms.zh_body:
通讯频道断断续续，地图上几处节点都变成噪点。能天使敲了敲耳机，确认不是设备坏了，而是这片区域的信号被压得太乱。

修复频道会花钱，强行推进会留下不确定性；也可以临时增幅信号，让下一段支援更快接上。

burden_resonance.en_body:
Exusai rarely lets heaviness show on her face. She prefers pushing the mood forward with jokes and gunfire. But this corridor is too quiet — quiet enough that the things left unsaid have all caught up with her.

She can turn the pressure into fiercer firepower, suppress the fluctuation for now, or channel this unease into the squad’s tactical network.
burden_resonance.zh_body:
能天使很少把沉重摆在脸上。她更习惯用玩笑和枪声把气氛往前推。但这条走廊太安静了，安静到那些没说出口的事都追了上来。

她可以把压力转成更猛烈的火力，也可以先压住波动，或者把这份不安导向队伍的战术网络。

dobermann_inspection.en_body:
Dobermann demands that Exusai lay out her current deck and ammo records. She frowns at the first glance: too casual, too trusting of in-the-moment feel, and too likely to send the tempo flying off.

Exusai says with a smile, "Isn't it still winning?", but Dobermann is not fooled. She points out every superfluous motion, every idle spin, and every card that fails to serve the rhythm of sustained fire.

You can trim the deck as Dobermann demands, push the training direction toward more aggressive firepower, or simply pull the squad back and keep this uncomfortable reminder.
dobermann_inspection.zh_body:
杜宾要求能天使把现在的牌组和弹药记录摊开。她看完第一眼就皱眉：太随性，太相信临场手感，也太容易把节奏打飞。

能天使笑着说「这不是还能赢嘛」，但杜宾没有被糊弄过去。她指出每一处多余动作、每一次空转、每张没有服务于连射节奏的牌。

你可以按杜宾的要求精简牌组，也可以把训练方向推向更激进的火力输出，或者干脆先收队，保留这份不太舒服的提醒。

doctor_question.en_body:
The Doctor gives no direct order, only asks Exusai: what do you want your firepower to protect next?

This is not a philosophical exercise. Your answer will tilt future rewards: more toward rescue and Support, more toward efficient bursts, or more toward taking on high risk.
doctor_question.zh_body:
博士没有直接下命令，只问能天使：下一步，你想把火力用来保护什么？

这不是哲学题。你的回答会影响后续奖励的倾向：更偏救援支援，更偏效率爆发，或者更偏高风险承担。

doctor_reflection.en_body:
Your earlier answer is recorded in the operation log. Now, the same question has become a concrete tactical choice: a squad has been ambushed, and Exusai must immediately decide on a form of support.

If you choose in line with your earlier route, the payoff will be stronger; if you choose differently, you may yet pull the current situation back toward a more suitable direction.
doctor_reflection.zh_body:
博士之前的回答被记录在行动日志里。现在，同样的问题变成了一个具体战术选择：一支小队被伏击，需要能天使立刻决定支援方式。

如果选择和之前路线一致，收益会更强；如果选择不同，也许能把当前局面拉回更适合的方向。

emergency_command_chain.en_body:
The front line demands an immediate allocation of firepower. Exusai has already marked several target points; all that remains is for you to confirm which line to hit first.

The faster you respond, the better you can turn chaos into tempo. You can reinforce this floor’s Support, accept higher risk for double rewards, or wire the tactical network directly into the deck.
emergency_command_chain.zh_body:
前线请求立刻给出火力分配。能天使已经把几个目标点标出来了，只差你确认先打哪条线。

越快回应，越能把混乱变成节奏。你可以强化本层支援，接受更高风险换双倍奖励，或者直接把战术网络接进牌组。

evacuation_aftermath.en_body:
At the entrance to the next floor, the signalman hands over a follow-up report on the evacuation. Exusai scans it and finds your earlier choices have already spread along the supply lines, public opinion, and the front’s advance.

You can now consolidate the supply line, exploit the advantage gained, or keep the deployment flexible.
evacuation_aftermath.zh_body:
下一层入口处，通讯兵递来一份撤离行动的后续报告。能天使扫了一眼，发现你之前的选择已经沿着补给线、舆论和前线推进扩散开了。

现在可以巩固补给线，利用推进优势，或者继续保持弹性部署。

footprints_on_ashes.en_body:
There is a trail of footprints in the ash, plus a very shallow set of cart tracks, their direction at odds with the map. Exusai glances at them and judges this does not look like flight — more like an invitation left behind deliberately.

You can follow the trail, trade it for rare card intelligence in hand, or mark the location for now and decide later.
footprints_on_ashes.zh_body:
灰里有一串脚印，还有一条很浅的车辙，方向和地图不一致。能天使看了一眼，判断这不像逃跑，更像有人故意留下的邀请。

可以沿着线索走，也可以把它换成眼前的稀有牌情报，或者先标记位置，之后再说。

intelligence_convergence.en_body:
Kal'tsit's route data and signal fragments intercepted from W's broadcast are laid out on the same terminal. Exusai studies them for a while, then suddenly links several seemingly unrelated points into a single firing line.

You can dig deeper into enemy deployments, extract combat tempo, or share the intelligence with the whole squad to make the entire operation run more smoothly.
intelligence_convergence.zh_body:
凯尔希的路线数据和 W 广播里截获的信号碎片被放到同一块终端上。能天使盯了一会儿，忽然把几个看似无关的点连成一条射击线。

你可以深入分析敌方部署，提取战斗节奏，或者把情报分享给全队，让整个行动更顺。

kaltsit_briefing.en_body:
Kal'tsit projects the new briefing onto the terminal. Her tone is still flat as a machine, but the routes, ambush points, and fire dead zones she has marked are all useful.

Exusai leans against the screen, her eyes first settling on a few of the best spots to set up a gun. The intelligence can be traded for a clearer route, or for a steadier combat tempo; if you are willing to sacrifice a little immediate speed, you can also trade for a rarer Support plan.

Kal'tsit does not rush. She only waits for you to turn this intelligence into something you can actually fire.
kaltsit_briefing.zh_body:
凯尔希把新简报投到终端上。她的语气还是平得像机器，但标注出来的路线、伏击点和火力死角都很有用。

能天使往屏幕上一靠，先盯住了几个最适合架枪的位置。情报可以换成更清晰的路线，也可以换成更稳的作战节奏；如果愿意牺牲一点眼前速度，还能换到更稀有的支援方案。

凯尔希没有催促。她只等你把这份情报变成能打出去的东西。

kaltsit_silent_assessment.en_body:
Kal'tsit offers no criticism of Exusai; she simply slides the operation record across the desk. That is more direct than criticism.

The record marks out dry-mag windows, over-pursuits, and several kill lines that could have been executed with far less effort. Exusai scratches her head and admits the report is probably quite useful.
kaltsit_silent_assessment.zh_body:
凯尔希没有批评能天使，只是把行动记录推到桌面上。那比批评更直接。

记录里标出了空弹窗口、过度追击和几处本可以更省力的击杀线。能天使挠挠头，承认这份报告大概挺有用。

medical_supply_crate.en_body:
Overturned transport crates still hold a batch of medical supplies. Exusai pats the lid to confirm it is still usable, and casually tucks a few rolls of bandage and an emergency syringe into her jacket pocket.

It is not much, but it is enough to decide whether you restore your condition first or strip it down into long-term security.
medical_supply_crate.zh_body:
翻倒的运输箱里还有一批医疗物资。能天使拍拍箱盖，确认它还能用，顺手把几卷绷带和一支应急针剂塞进外套口袋。

这些东西不多，但足够决定你接下来是先恢复状态，还是把它拆成长期保障。

mental_fluctuation.en_body:
In the quiet after combat, the halo above Exusai’s head flickers once. Not a malfunction — more like a beat disrupted by battlefield noise.

She smiles and says it is nothing, but you can hear her forcing that bit of static back into the rhythm. You can suppress the fluctuation and clear away the interference, or acknowledge this pressure and turn it into the next round of firepower.
mental_fluctuation.zh_body:
战斗后的安静里，能天使头顶的光环轻轻闪了一下。不是故障，更像是一段被战场噪声干扰的节拍。

她笑着说没事，但你能听出来，她正在努力把那点杂音压回节奏里。你可以强行压住波动，清理掉干扰，也可以承认这份压力，把它转成下一轮火力。

midnight_maintenance.en_body:
The night holds only the sound of tools, oiling, and Exusai humming. She strips the firearm apart, moving as quickly as if doing a familiar chore.

You can now adjust the charm, focus on the Channel and Reload routes, or take a module that makes the first stretch of Echo flow more smoothly.
midnight_maintenance.zh_body:
夜里只剩工具声、上油声和能天使哼歌的声音。她拆开铳械，动作快得像在做一件很熟的家务。

现在可以调整护符，也可以专心处理引导和装填路线，或者拿走一个能让第一段回响更顺的模块。

nameless_operator_letter.en_body:
A request slip that never got delivered lies pinned beneath shattered armor. Not a final letter — more like an unfinished delivery record, its handwriting grown ragged toward the end.

Exusai falls quiet for a moment, then folds the paper. You can carry this wish with you, steady the squad first, or write the name down.
nameless_operator_letter.zh_body:
一张没来得及送出的委托单被压在破碎护甲下面。不是遗书，更像一份没完成的配送记录，字迹到最后已经有些乱。

能天使安静了一会儿，然后把纸折好。你可以带走这份愿望，先稳定队伍，或者把名字记下来。

nearl_principle.en_body:
Nearl stops in front of the collapsed checkpoint. The trapped people are not far off, and enemy patrols are closing in. Exusai looks up at the route, calculating how many rounds of suppression fire it will take to get from cover to the rear of the vehicle.

Nearl does not demand that you sacrifice efficiency, but her meaning is clear: if you can save them and yet do not, every shot you fire afterward will sit a little less easily.

Exusai can cover the evacuation with fire, race to seize the mission objective first, or split into two teams and divide the risk between them.
nearl_principle.zh_body:
临光在坍塌的检查口前停下。被困的人就在不远处，敌方巡逻也在靠近。能天使抬头看了看路线，计算着从掩体到车尾需要几轮压制射击。

临光没有要求你一定要牺牲效率，但她的意思很清楚：如果能救却不救，那之后每一次开火都会变得没那么轻松。

能天使可以用火力护送撤离，也可以优先抢占任务目标，或者拆成两组行动，把风险分开承担。

old_operation_record.en_body:
An old terminal still holds fragments of past operations. Half the audio is corrupted, sounding like a scratched record. Exusai rather likes it, copying down the usable tactical fragments as she listens.

You can dig through it for tempo cards and fire routes, or preserve the terminal for continued use later.
old_operation_record.zh_body:
一块旧终端还存着过去行动的片段。音频坏了一半，听起来像被刮花的唱片。能天使倒是挺喜欢，边听边把能用的战术片段抄进终端。

你可以从里面找节奏牌、找火力路线，也可以把终端保存下来，后续继续用。

operator_assembly.en_body:
Several operators meet at a temporary assembly point. Exusai dumps the supply bag onto the table, and the mood lightens at once.

Everyone has a suggestion to offer: add a Support card, upgrade the Support chain, or wire a set of array modules into the current operation. There is only time for one.
operator_assembly.zh_body:
几名干员在临时会合点碰头。能天使把补给袋往桌上一扔，气氛一下轻松不少。

每个人都能给出一条建议：补一张支援牌，升级支援链，或者把一套阵列模块接进当前行动。时间只够选一种。

originium_aftershock.en_body:
The aftereffects of the earlier contact with the Originium echo have yet to fully disperse. Every time Exusai reloads, she hears an odd extra echo in the clatter of falling casings.

Controlled well, this aftershock can become a combat asset; compressed into structure, it can become a stable module; purged entirely, it is safer, but you give up this power.
originium_aftershock.zh_body:
之前接触源石回声的影响还没完全散去。能天使每次换弹时，都能听见弹壳落地声里多出一点奇怪的回响。

如果控制得好，这份余震能变成战斗收益；如果压缩进结构里，也能成为稳定模块；彻底净化则更安全，但会放弃这份力量。

originium_echo_corridor.en_body:
The long corridor throws every gunshot back at you. Originium embedded in the walls drags the echoes into strange trailing notes.

Exusai finds the rhythm quickly: here you can tune a card to suit chaining, shave its cost, or take a locking anchor that makes Marks harder to dissipate.
originium_echo_corridor.zh_body:
长廊会把每一声枪响反弹回来。源石嵌在墙体里，让回声拖出奇怪的尾音。

能天使很快就找到了节奏：这里可以把一张牌调成更适合连锁，也可以压低费用，或者取走让标记更难消散的锁定锚点。

originium_fissure.en_body:
The street has split open, and Originium dust drifts out like gray fog. Exusai squints at it for a while, then notices the flow of the dust betrays hidden air currents and the edges of cover.

It is dangerous here, but it can be turned to advantage. You can record the Originium structure, take a fragment, or simply go around and not carry the trouble into your magazine.
originium_fissure.zh_body:
街面裂开，源石粉尘像灰色的雾一样往外飘。能天使眯着眼看了一会儿，发现粉尘流动会暴露一些隐藏的气流和掩体边缘。

这里危险，但也能变成优势。你可以记录源石结构，取走碎片，或者直接绕开，不把麻烦带进弹匣。

overloaded_supply.en_body:
The Originium devices in the supply crate have overheated, their casings too hot to touch. Exusai crouches for a look and offers a highly professional verdict: "Usable, but I wouldn’t recommend running with it in your arms."

Continuing to strip it may trade for an Energy supply or a more dangerous firepower card; you can also dispose of it safely and leave the risk where it lies.
overloaded_supply.zh_body:
补给箱里的源石装置已经过热，外壳烫得不能直接碰。能天使蹲下看了一眼，评价非常专业：「能用，但最好别抱着它跑。」

继续拆可能换来能量补给或更危险的火力牌，也可以安全处理，把风险留在原地。

tactical_debrief.en_body:
A few screens still glow in the makeshift debrief room, looping the fire trajectories of the exchange just now. Exusai sips a drink, dragging several trajectories into a single line with a fingertip.

This is not the kind of debrief that leaves you gasping, but it is very practical: which card needs upgrading, which Support chain is worth keeping, and which noise should be cleared from the deck — all of it is obvious at a glance.
tactical_debrief.zh_body:
临时复盘室里还亮着几块屏幕，上面循环播放刚才的交火轨迹。能天使一边喝饮料，一边用指尖把几条弹道拖到同一条线上。

这不是严肃到让人喘不过气的复盘，但很实用：哪张牌该升级，哪条支援链该保留，哪些杂讯该从牌组里清掉，一眼就能看出来。

temporary_ward.en_body:
A small shop with its display window shot through has been converted into a makeshift aid point. Exusai sets the supply crate on the counter, still joking even as her hands already begin counting medicine, bandages, and remaining magazines.

Among the wounded are civilians, and operators who can still push on with the squad. She is not good at making the mood heavy, but she knows full well that not enough is not enough. The aid point must hold, and the front line needs bodies too.

A quick decision is needed now: spend money to prop up the aid point, split the resources evenly, or leave more supplies for the next firefight.
temporary_ward.zh_body:
一间被打穿橱窗的小店临时改成了救护点。能天使把补给箱往柜台上一放，嘴上还在开玩笑，手却已经开始清点药剂、绷带和剩下的弹匣。

伤员里有平民，也有还能跟着队伍继续推进的干员。她不太擅长把气氛讲得沉重，但她很清楚，补给不够就是不够。救护点要稳住，前线也要有人顶着。

现在得快速做决定：花钱把救护点撑起来，平均拆分资源，或者把更多补给留给下一场交火。

withdrawal_dispute.en_body:
The evacuation route is blocked; the civilian column and the main squad can only protect one for now. Exusai, rarely letting the jokes drop, studies the map and starts calculating which route can open the widest suppression gap with the fewest bullets.

There is no perfect answer. Protecting civilians slows the advance; protecting the main force makes for a cleaner route; splitting into teams means both sides must shoulder the risk.
withdrawal_dispute.zh_body:
撤离路线被堵住，平民队伍和主力小队只能先保一边。能天使难得没立刻开玩笑，她看着地图，开始计算哪条路线能用最少子弹打出最大的压制空隙。

没有完美答案。保平民会拖慢推进，保主力会让路线更干净，分队行动则意味着两边都得承担风险。

ws_broadcast.en_body:
The comms channel is suddenly seized by W. She laughs lightly, as though she has already planted the charges at your feet and is only waiting for you to look down.

Exusai pushes her headset up, her tone easy enough: "Wow, she really knows how to steal a channel." Yet her finger is already resting beside the trigger. The broadcast is laced with route fragments, explosion triggers, and deliberately planted false signals.

You can chase the signal and counter her ambush, pick the demolition rhythm apart first, or simply decline to act in her little play.
ws_broadcast.zh_body:
通讯频道突然被 W 抢走。她笑得很轻，像是已经把炸点埋在你脚边，只等你低头看。

能天使把耳机往上推了推，语气倒是轻松：「哇，这人好会抢频道。」可她手指已经搭在扳机旁边。广播里混着路线碎片、爆炸触发和故意留下的假信号。

你可以追着信号反打她的伏击，也可以把爆破节奏先拆出来，或者干脆不陪她演这场戏。

battle.status_ammo.en:
Ammo %d/%d
Shot cards spend Ammo. Exusiai defaults to 3 Energy and draws 5, with a hand limit of 10. Prepare Ammo, Reload, and Mark before using next-turn Burst for +2 Energy and +2 draw.
battle.status_ammo.zh:
弹药 %d/%d
射击 牌会直接消耗弹药。能天使默认 3 能量、抽 5 张，手牌上限为 10；先准备 弹药 / 装填 / 标记，再用 爆发 的下一回合 +2 能量、+2 抽牌打连射。

battle.status_burst.en:
Burst turn
The prepared firing window is active. This turn already gained +2 Energy and +2 draw. Shots gain +1 damage; the 2nd Shot draws 1, and the 3rd Shot refunds 1 Ammo and deals 3 extra damage, once each.
battle.status_burst.zh:
爆发回合
准备完成后进入的强化连射窗口。本回合已经获得 +2 能量、+2 抽牌；射击 额外 +1 伤害；第 2 张 射击 抽 1，第 3 张 射击 返还 1 弹药 并追加 3 点伤害，各触发一次。

battle.status_burst_prepared.en:
Burst prepared
At the start of your next player turn, enter Burst: +2 Energy, +2 draw, and Shot cadence enabled. Preparing again only refreshes next-turn Burst; it does not stack multiple times.
battle.status_burst_prepared.zh:
爆发 已准备
下个玩家回合开始时进入爆发回合：能量 +2，抽牌 +2，并启用 射击 连射节拍。重复准备只会刷新这个下回合爆发，不会叠加多次。

battle.status_counter.en:
Counter %d
When an enemy actively attacks Nearl, if she had Block before the hit, each enemy can trigger Counter once per turn. Current Radiance +%d, expected Counter damage %d.
battle.status_counter.zh:
反击 %d
敌人主动攻击临光时，若临光在受击前有护盾，则每个敌人每回合最多触发一次反击。当前光耀 +%d，预计反击伤害 %d。

battle.status_leader_ready.en:
Leader buff ready
After your first Support this turn, the next Arts card gains +2 damage.
battle.status_leader_ready.zh:
领袖加成已就绪
你本回合第一次打出支援牌后，下一张术式牌固定 +2 伤害。

battle.status_mark.en:
Mark %d
Mark is Exusiai's targeting resource. Marked enemies give better Shot payoffs, and finishers can cash Mark out for damage. Without a lock effect, enemies usually lose 1 Mark at the end of their turn.
battle.status_mark.zh:
标记 %d
标记 是能天使用来锁定收割目标的层数资源。带 标记 的敌人会吃到更多 射击 收益，终结牌可把 标记 整批转成伤害。若没有锁定效果，敌人回合结束后通常会掉 1 层。

battle.status_next_damage_reduction.en:
Next hit reduction %d
Prevents this much damage before the next enemy damage is resolved.
battle.status_next_damage_reduction.zh:
下一次受击减伤 %d
会在下一次敌方伤害结算前抵消等量伤害。

battle.status_radiance.en:
Radiance %d/5
Nearl's battle-long layered resource. Each stack adds +1 Counter damage. Current bonuses: Block +%d, Heal +%d.
battle.status_radiance.zh:
光耀 %d/5
临光的战斗内层数资源。每层让反击伤害 +1；当前让护盾 +%d、治疗 +%d。

battle.status_reload.en:
Reload queued %d
This ammo is already queued and will be restored at turn end or next turn start. The more you have queued, the easier it is to continue firing next cycle.
battle.status_reload.zh:
待装填 %d
这些弹药已经排进装填队列，会在回合结束或下回合开始时补回。待装填越多，下一轮越适合继续连射。

battle.status_resonance.en:
Resonance %d
Resonance does not increase damage on its own. It is a layered resource attached to a unit. Cards like Collapse Frequency cash it out for 3 Arts damage per stack, while Chimera Protocol converts it to 4 Arts per stack. Unless protected, enemies usually lose 1 stack at the end of their turn.
battle.status_resonance.zh:
共振 %d
共振本身不会直接增伤，它是挂在单位身上的层数资源。像「频域崩塌」会每层造成 3 点术式伤害，「嵌合协议」会每层转成 4 点术式伤害。若没有特殊效果保护，敌人回合结束后通常会减少 1 层。

battle.status_strength.en:
Strength %d
This unit deals +%d extra damage.
battle.status_strength.zh:
力量 %d
该单位造成伤害时额外 +%d。

battle.status_vulnerable.en:
Vulnerable %d
This unit takes 50%% more damage. It usually loses 1 stack after its next action.
battle.status_vulnerable.zh:
易伤 %d
该单位受到的伤害增加 50%%。通常会在完成下一次行动后减少 1 层。

battle.status_weak.en:
Weak %d
This unit deals 25%% less damage. It usually loses 1 stack after its next action.
battle.status_weak.zh:
虚弱 %d
该单位造成的伤害减少 25%%。通常会在完成下一次行动后减少 1 层。

battle.status_will.en:
Will %d
Current Will adds +%d damage to Echo Conduit. At 4+ Will, Resonance Burst gains +%d damage.
battle.status_will.zh:
意志 %d
当前意志会让「回响导流」额外 +%d 伤害；若意志达到 4 点以上，「谐振爆发」额外 +%d 伤害。

codex.term_ammo_body.en: Ammo is Exusiai's exclusive resource. She starts combat loaded, and many Shot cards need Ammo to resolve their full output. Reloads, refills, Burst cadence, and modules restore Ammo, so the key is preparing reloads before chaining a Burst turn.
codex.term_ammo_body.zh: 弹药是能天使的专属资源。她开局会装满弹药，很多 射击 牌会消耗 弹药 才能结算完整伤害；弹药不够时，多段射击和爆发牌通常会断档。装填、补弹、爆发节拍和部分模块会把 弹药 补回来，所以能天使的关键是先铺补弹，再抓住爆发回合连射。

codex.term_aoe_body.en: Area damage hits multiple enemies at once. It is especially important against swarms, drones, and summoned units, though its single-target numbers are usually lower than dedicated finishers.
codex.term_aoe_body.zh: 范围伤害会一次命中多个敌人。它在处理虫群、无人机和召唤物时尤其关键，但通常单体面板会比纯点杀牌低。

codex.term_arts_body.en: Cards with the Arts tag benefit from Amiya's most important synergy and serve as her main damage source. In the current prototype, after Amiya plays her first Support each turn, her next Arts card gets a flat +2 damage. With `Ashen Thread`, the next Arts card after self-damage gains an additional +3.
codex.term_arts_body.zh: 带有术式标签的牌会吃到阿米娅最核心的联动，也是她主要的伤害来源。当前原型里，阿米娅每回合第一次打出支援牌后，下一张术式牌固定 +2 伤害；如果带着 `灰烬丝线` 模块并且你刚刚自伤过，下一张术式还会再额外 +3。

codex.term_block_body.en: Block absorbs damage before HP is lost. It is the most direct defensive resource and helps you survive bursts or buy extra turns.
codex.term_block_body.zh: 护盾会先替你承受伤害，再扣生命。它是最直接的防御资源，适合拿来顶一轮爆发或者拖回合。

codex.term_burst_body.en: Burst is Exusiai's next-turn empowered firing window. Playing a Burst card does not activate immediately; it gives Prepare, then at the start of your next player turn Burst activates with +2 Energy and +2 draw. During Burst, Shots gain +1 damage; the second Shot draws 1, and the third Shot refunds 1 Ammo and deals 3 extra damage.
codex.term_burst_body.zh: 爆发回合是能天使的下一回合强化连射窗口。打出 爆发 牌时不会当场爆发，而是获得“备”：下个玩家回合开始进入 爆发，能量 +2、抽牌 +2。进入 爆发 后，射击 +1 伤害；第 2 张 射击 抽 1，第 3 张 射击 返还 1 弹药 并追加 3 点伤害。它不是常驻增益，而是先铺 弹药 / 标记 / 装填，再用下一回合 爆发 一口气清场或点杀。

codex.term_channel_body.en: Channel cards do not resolve their main payoff immediately. Instead, they store the effect and trigger it later, usually at the next turn start or the end of the turn. They are great for preloading bursts, reloads, or tempo turns, but they ask you to survive the delay first.
codex.term_channel_body.zh: 引导牌不会把主要收益立刻结算，而是先把效果存起来，等到下回合开始或回合结束时再触发。它们适合提前铺垫爆发、补弹或节奏转折，但也意味着你要先撑过这一拍。

codex.term_command_body.en: The Command tag marks cards that directly alter sequencing, trigger order, or support tempo in the current turn. They usually do not hit hard on their own, but they make the rest of the turn cleaner through refunds, discounts, or early payoff windows.
codex.term_command_body.zh: 指挥标签代表这张牌会直接改动你本回合的出牌顺序、收益触发或支援节奏。它通常不会自己造成高伤害，但会让后面的牌更顺：像返还能量、让下一张牌减费，或把支援收益提前兑现。

codex.term_curse_body.en: Curse cards usually do not help and only clog the deck, slowing your tempo or directly causing penalties. In the current prototype: `Hesitation` makes you lose 1 Will if it remains in hand at end of turn, `Panic Static` makes your first card cost +1 when drawn, and `Blast Countdown` deals 8 damage if it is still in hand at end of turn.
codex.term_curse_body.zh: 诅咒牌一般帮不上忙，只会塞进牌堆拖慢节奏，严重时还会直接带来惩罚。当前原型里：`迟疑` 若回合结束还在手里会失去 1 点意志；`恐慌静电` 抽到时会让你本回合第一张牌费用 +1；`爆破倒计时` 若回合结束还留在手里，会直接受到 8 点伤害。

codex.term_echo_body.en: Echo means your next Arts card repeats part of its effect. The most common form in the prototype is 50%% Echo, which repeats 50%% of the card's base effect. `Echo Lattice` grants 50%% Echo, `Sevenfold Echo` gives the next 2 Arts cards 50%% Echo, and `Mirrored Wave` repeats its base damage again if Echo is active.
codex.term_echo_body.zh: 回响代表「下一张术式会额外触发一次部分效果」。当前原型里最常见的是 50%%回响，也就是再触发一次基础效果的 50%%。`回响格` 会给予 50%%回响；`七重回响` 会给接下来 2 张术式牌 50%%回响；如果你有 `镜波`，带着 回响 时还会再额外重复一次基础伤害。

codex.term_energy_body.en: Playing cards costs Energy. All characters now start each turn with 3 base Energy. Exusiai no longer has innate extra Energy; instead, preparing Burst grants +2 Energy and +2 draw on the next turn for her firing window. `Reserve Battery` adds +1 Energy on turn one.
codex.term_energy_body.zh: 每回合打牌都要花能量。所有角色默认基础能量都是 3；能天使不再天生高能量，而是通过准备 爆发，在下一回合获得 +2 能量和 +2 抽牌来打出连射高潮。如果带着 `备用电池`，第一回合会额外 +1 能量。

codex.term_ethereal_body.en: A card with Ethereal disappears if it is still in your hand at the end of the turn. This often appears on curses or time-sensitive opportunity cards.
codex.term_ethereal_body.zh: 带有飘忽的牌如果回合结束时还留在手里，也会直接消失。常见于诅咒或一些限时机会牌。

codex.term_exhaust_body.en: A card with Exhaust goes to the exhaust pile after being played and will not cycle back during that battle. These cards are usually powerful one-shot effects.
codex.term_exhaust_body.zh: 带有消耗的牌在本场战斗里打出后会进入消耗堆，不会再回到弃牌堆循环。它们往往是一次性的大效果。

codex.term_finisher_body.en: Finishers are heavy closing blows meant to secure a kill. They usually are not efficient as openers, but become excellent once marks, burst, will, or other conditions are already prepared. A good finisher cashes an entire setup turn into a clean kill.
codex.term_finisher_body.zh: 终结牌就是用来收人头的重击牌。它们通常不适合开场乱拍，而是要等你先把标记、爆发、意志或其他条件垫好，再把关键目标一口气带走。打得好的时候，终结牌会把前面所有铺垫一次性兑现成斩杀。

codex.term_heal_body.en: Healing restores missing HP directly, but never beyond max HP. Unlike Block, it repairs damage after the fact instead of preventing it up front. It is rarer in Amiya's pool and more common in support lines or later operators.
codex.term_heal_body.zh: 回复会直接把已经损失的生命补回来，但不会超过最大生命值。它和护盾不同，属于事后修复而不是提前挡伤。阿米娅这边比较少见，更多会出现在支援线或后续角色的牌组里。

codex.term_integrity_body.en: Integrity is Mon3tr's structural value. It starts combat at 3/10; from Kal'tsit's second turn onward, it repairs 1 at the start of each turn. At 1 or 2 Integrity, Mon3tr becomes Critical and deals less damage.
codex.term_integrity_body.zh: 完整性是 Mon3tr 的结构值。普通上限为 10，战斗开始为 3/10；从第二个凯尔希回合开始，每回合自动修复 1。低于 3 时 Mon3tr 进入临界状态，伤害降低。

codex.term_mark_body.en: Mark is a stack of target lock on enemies. It is not ordinary Vulnerable; it is Exusiai's targeting resource. Some Shots gain extra damage against marked enemies, and finishers cash Mark out. Enemies usually lose 1 Mark at the end of their turn.
codex.term_mark_body.zh: 标记是挂在敌人身上的锁定层数。标记 本身不是普通易伤，而是能天使用来指定收割目标的资源：部分 射击 会对带 标记 的敌人追加伤害，终结牌会把 标记 整批兑现。默认敌人回合结束后会掉 1 层，所以要在衰减前集中火力。

codex.term_medical_body.en: Medical cards heal Kal'tsit, grant Block, or repair Mon3tr. Many Kal'tsit synergies check whether a Medical card was played this turn.
codex.term_medical_body.zh: 医疗牌主要治疗凯尔希、提供护盾，或修复 Mon3tr。凯尔希的许多联动会检查本回合是否使用过医疗牌。

codex.term_meltdown_body.en: When Mon3tr reaches max Integrity, it automatically enters Meltdown. Kal'tsit attacks and Mon3tr damage gain +50%, Mon3tr ignores enemy Block, and Meltdown ends below 5 Integrity.
codex.term_meltdown_body.zh: 当 Mon3tr 达到当前完整性上限时自动进入融毁。融毁中凯尔希攻击与 Mon3tr 伤害 +50%，Mon3tr 伤害无视敌方护盾；若完整性低于 5，则退出融毁。

codex.term_mon3tr_body.en: Mon3tr is Kal'tsit's persistent summon. Command cards usually make Mon3tr attack, and its damage is affected by Integrity and Meltdown.
codex.term_mon3tr_body.zh: Mon3tr 是凯尔希的常驻召唤物。指令牌通常会让 Mon3tr 攻击，伤害会受到完整性与融毁状态影响。

codex.term_multihit_body.en: Multi-hit means a card resolves its damage in several separate hits. It is strong against swarms, shields, and on-hit synergies. When strength, mark, or similar per-hit bonuses are active, multi-hit cards magnify those benefits more clearly.
codex.term_multihit_body.zh: 连击代表一张牌会分成多段伤害结算。它更适合打虫群、削护盾和吃多次命中联动；如果目标带着力量、标记或其他逐段结算的修正，连击通常会把这些收益放大得更明显。

codex.term_overload_body.en: Overload is not a single status icon but a high-risk play pattern. You trade self-damage, reduced draw, or tempo loss for stronger Arts bursts. In the current prototype, the clearest examples are `Burn Will`, which trades 4 HP for 3 Will, and `Overclock Arts`, which deals 16 Arts damage and then costs 3 HP.
codex.term_overload_body.zh: 过载不是单独一个状态图标，而是一种高风险打法。你会用自伤、少抽牌或节奏损失，去换更高的术式爆发。当前原型里最直接的例子是：`燃烧意志` 会失去 4 点生命换 3 点意志，`术式超频` 会先打出 16 点术式伤害，再失去 3 点生命。

codex.term_protocol_body.en: Protocol cards are mostly long-term Powers that improve Medical, Repair, Command, or Meltdown loops. They form the backbone of late Kal'tsit builds.
codex.term_protocol_body.zh: 协议牌多为长期能力，会强化医疗、修复、指令或融毁循环。它们是凯尔希后期构筑的骨架。

codex.term_reload_body.en: Reload does not always refill ammo immediately. Many reload cards simply queue ammo first, then restore it at turn end or the next turn start. In practice, reload is about preparing the next firing cycle before the current one runs dry.
codex.term_reload_body.zh: 装填不一定立刻回弹。很多装填牌只是先把弹药排进待装填队列，然后在回合结束或下回合开始时补回。它的本质是“把下一轮火力提前准备好”，所以装填牌通常更适合接在爆发回合前，或者用来把空仓状态重新接回节奏。

codex.term_repair_body.en: Repair restores Mon3tr Integrity. Reaching the current maximum automatically starts Command: Meltdown, so Repair is both defense and Kal'tsit's burst starter.
codex.term_repair_body.zh: 修复会恢复 Mon3tr 的完整性。达到当前上限时会自动启动“指令：融毁”，所以修复牌既是防御手段，也是凯尔希的爆发启动器。

codex.term_rescue_body.en: Rescue cards and events represent Amiya diverting resources to save people. They usually do not create the biggest immediate damage, but they can pay off through gold, story flags, or stronger long-term rewards. For example, `Rescue Corridor` currently costs 1, grants 6 Block, and immediately gives 10 Gold.
codex.term_rescue_body.zh: 救援类牌和事件代表阿米娅把资源分出去救人。它们通常不会立刻打出最高伤害，但会换来金币、剧情标记或更好的长期收益。比如 `救援走廊` 当前就是 1 费，给 6 点护盾并立即获得 10 金币。

codex.term_resonance_body.en: Resonance is another core resource line in Amiya's deck, capped at 9 stacks per target. It does not deal damage by itself, but many cards convert it into burst: `Resonance Mark` applies 3 stacks, `Frequency Lock` applies 2, `Collapse Frequency` consumes all stacks for 3 Arts damage each, and `Chimera Protocol` converts each stack into 4 Arts damage. In short, Resonance is a delayed layer resource that you stack first and detonate later.
codex.term_resonance_body.zh: 共振是阿米娅牌组里另一条很核心的资源线，单个目标最多可叠到 9 层。它本身不会直接造成伤害，但很多牌会把共振转成爆发：`共振标记` 直接施加 3 层；`频锁` 施加 2 层；`频域崩塌` 会消耗目标全部共振，每层造成 3 点术式伤害；`嵌合协议` 还会把目标的每层共振转成 4 点术式伤害。简单说，共振就是你先挂在敌人身上、再择机一次性引爆的层数资源。

codex.term_scalpel_body.en: Scalpel marks Kal'tsit's own attack cards. During Meltdown, Kal'tsit Attack card damage is increased by 50%.
codex.term_scalpel_body.zh: 手术切击代表凯尔希自己的攻击牌。融毁中，凯尔希攻击牌伤害会提高 50%。

codex.term_shot_body.en: The Shot tag is Exusiai's main damage tag. Shot cards benefit from Ammo, Mark, Burst, and shot-specific modules. Exusiai normally has 3 Energy and draws 5; her power turn comes from preparing Burst, then using +2 Energy and +2 draw next turn to chain Shots. During Burst, Shots gain +1 damage; the second Shot draws 1, and the third Shot refunds 1 Ammo and deals 3 extra damage. Each cadence trigger happens once per turn.
codex.term_shot_body.zh: 射击标签是能天使的主输出轴。射击 牌会吃弹药、标记、爆发窗口和射击专属模块。能天使平时也是 3 能量、抽 5 张；她的强回合来自提前准备 爆发，下一回合用 +2 能量、+2 抽牌把 射击 连成一整轮。爆发 中 射击 额外 +1 伤害；本回合第 2 张 射击 抽 1，第 3 张 射击 返还 1 弹药 并追加 3 点伤害，这些节拍每回合各触发一次。

codex.term_slow_body.en: Slow lowers the damage a unit deals. In the current prototype it works like Weak and multiplies damage by 0.75, or 25%% less. It mainly comes from `Frostleaf Delay Field` and usually decays by 1 after that unit completes its next action.
codex.term_slow_body.zh: 迟滞会压低单位造成的伤害。当前原型里它和虚弱一样，会让伤害乘 0.75，也就是少 25%%。它主要来自 `霜叶·迟滞领域`，通常会在该单位完成下一次行动后减掉 1 层。

codex.term_status_body.en: Status cards are not curses, but they also do not behave like normal value cards. They usually represent temporary contamination, overload byproducts, or battlefield clutter. Some only slow you down, while others can be exploited as resources in the right build.
codex.term_status_body.zh: 状态牌不是诅咒，但通常也不会像正常牌那样稳定赚钱。它们往往代表临时污染、过载副产物或战场杂质。有些状态牌会拖节奏，有些则能在特定构筑里被当成资源反过来利用。

codex.term_strain_body.en: Mental Strain is not a separate meter but the real cost you pay for high burst turns. In the current prototype it appears in three main forms: 1. direct HP loss, such as `Burn Will` for -4 HP, `Overclock Arts` for -3 HP, and W's rule dealing 2 self-damage every third card; 2. Will loss, such as `Hesitation` causing -1 Will if left in hand; and 3. tempo penalties, such as `Panic Static` making your first card cost +1.
codex.term_strain_body.zh: 精神负荷不是单独的状态条，而是你为高爆发付出的实际代价。当前原型里它主要表现为 3 种东西：1. 直接掉生命，例如 `燃烧意志` -4 生命、`术式超频` -3 生命、W 规则下每打出第 3 张牌自伤 2。2. 失去意志，例如 `迟疑` 留手回合结束 -1 意志。3. 节奏惩罚，例如 `恐慌静电` 让第一张牌费用 +1。

codex.term_strength_body.en: Strength adds directly to the damage a unit deals. In the current prototype, 1 Strength means +1 damage on each hit. If an enemy shows an 8-damage attack and has 2 Strength, it resolves from 10 before Weak, Vulnerable, and Block are applied.
codex.term_strength_body.zh: 力量会直接加到一个单位造成的伤害上。当前原型里，1 点力量就让每次攻击额外 +1 伤害；如果敌人头顶显示 8 点打击并且它有 2 点力量，结算时就会按 10 点去算，再继续套虚弱、易伤和护盾。

codex.term_support_body.en: Support cards focus on draw, energy refunds, tempo control, or retrieving key tools. Numerically, the big payoff is this: after Amiya plays her first Support each turn, her next Arts card gets a flat +2 damage; with `Field Command Badge`, that first Support also refunds 1 extra Energy.
codex.term_support_body.zh: 支援牌偏向抽牌、返还能量、调整节奏或找回关键牌。数值上最关键的是：阿米娅每回合第一次打出支援牌后，下一张术式固定 +2 伤害；如果装着 `战场指令徽章`，这第一次支援还会额外返还 1 点能量。

codex.term_tactic_body.en: Tactic cards prioritize routing over raw damage. They often tutor, draw, cycle cards, adjust costs, or set up the next play before it resolves. In short, tactic cards are used to make the turn line up correctly.
codex.term_tactic_body.zh: 战术牌偏重调度而不是硬打输出。它们常见的工作是检索、抽牌、换牌、调整下一张牌的费用或给后续行动先挂好条件。简单说，战术牌是用来把这一回合排顺的。

codex.term_tempo_body.en: Tempo describes whether you can chain enough plays, ammo refills, and energy refunds before enemy pressure comes online. Exusiai depends on tempo heavily because losing speed does not just cost one card, it often breaks ammo flow, multi-hit chains, and Burst setup all at once.
codex.term_tempo_body.zh: 节奏指的是你能不能在敌人起势前，先把出牌数、补弹和返还能量接起来。能天使特别吃节奏，因为她掉速之后不只是少打一张牌，而是会同时断弹药、断连射、断爆发。看起来像在攒资源，其实是在保住整轮火力不断档。

codex.term_vulnerable_body.en: A unit with Vulnerable takes 1.5x damage, or 50% more. In the current prototype, 1 stack usually decays after that unit completes its next action. For example, 10 damage becomes 15 against a Vulnerable target.
codex.term_vulnerable_body.zh: 带有易伤的单位会受到 1.5 倍伤害，也就是多吃 50%。当前原型里，如果某个单位挂着 1 层易伤，这层通常会在它完成下一次行动后自动减掉。比如原本 10 点伤害，打到易伤目标身上会变成 15。

codex.term_weak_body.en: A unit with Weak deals damage at 0.75x, which means a direct 25% reduction. In the current prototype, 1 stack of Weak usually lasts until that unit finishes its next action, then decays by 1. For example, an attack that would deal 8 instead deals 6 under Weak.
codex.term_weak_body.zh: 带有虚弱的单位造成的伤害会乘以 0.75，也就是直接少 25%。当前原型里，1 层虚弱通常会持续到这个单位完成下一次行动为止，然后自动减掉 1 层。比如敌人原本打 8，挂上虚弱后会变成 6。

codex.term_will_body.en: Amiya's exclusive resource, capped at 10. It does not passively boost every card, but it clearly empowers some burst Arts: `Mind Alignment` and `Discipline Note` each grant +1 Will, `Burn Will` grants +3, `Echo Conduit` gains +1 damage per Will up to +6, and `Resonance Burst` gains +4 damage at 4+ Will. High Will also carries risk because it is often tied to self-damage, tempo loss, or overload lines.
codex.term_will_body.zh: 阿米娅的专属资源，上限 10。它不会自动让所有牌统一增伤，但会明确强化部分爆发术式：`精神校准` 与 `纪律便签` 各给 +1 意志，`燃烧意志` 给 +3 意志；`回响导流` 会额外获得「每 1 点意志 +1 伤害」，最多 +6；`共振爆发` 在意志达到 4 以上时额外 +4 伤害。意志越高，风险也越高，因为它经常和自伤、节奏损失或过载打法绑在一起。

single.amiya_header.zh: 阿米娅 | 罗德岛领袖

single.amiya_intro.en: Amiya is the young leader of Rhodes Island, wielding powerful Arts and personally stepping onto the front lines. In this build she is a high-growth, high-cost caster leader—capable of burst damage while driving overall tempo through Support cards. Her command of Arts and Resonance makes her stronger as a fight unfolds.
single.amiya_intro.zh: 阿米娅是罗德岛的年轻领袖，擅长强力术式，并会亲自奔赴前线解决问题。在这套构筑中，她是高成长、高代价的术师领袖——既能打出爆发伤害，也能通过支援牌带动全局节奏。作为领袖，她对术式与共振的驾驭让她在战局中越打越强。

single.amiya_stats.en: HP 72/72    Starting Energy 4    Core Resource: Will
single.amiya_stats.zh: 生命 72/72    起始能量 4    核心资源：意志

single.amiya_will.en:
Signature Mechanic: Will
Will is Amiya's exclusive resource (cap 10). Several cards build Will, and the more Will she has, the stronger her advanced Arts become—finishers and burst spells scale directly with it.
But high Will carries pressure: some cards spend it, and overload-style lines can cause self-damage or tempo loss. In short, Will is the system that turns Amiya's burden into combat power.
single.amiya_will.zh:
特有机制：意志
意志是阿米娅的专属资源（上限 10）。部分卡牌会积累意志，意志越高，她的高阶术式就越强——终结牌和爆发牌都会随意志提升伤害。
但意志并非越高越好：它代表精神负荷与承担的代价。部分牌会消耗意志，某些过载打法还会带来自伤或节奏风险。简单来说，意志就是阿米娅把「责任」转化为力量的核心系统。

tutorial.body.en:
Welcome to Ashen Loop. Here is a quick briefing on core mechanics:

• Playing Cards: Click a card in hand, then choose a target (enemy or self) to play it. Each card has an energy cost shown in the top-left.
• Enemy Intent: The icon above each enemy shows its next action (attack/defend/buff). The number on attack icons is damage.
• Block: Damage is absorbed by block first. Block resets at the start of your turn.
• End Turn: Press the End Turn button at bottom-right. Unplayed cards are discarded.
• Goal: Defeat all enemies to win. If HP reaches zero, the run ends.

Choose nodes on the map to advance. Rest sites heal or upgrade/remove cards. Shops sell supplies. Good luck, Doctor.
tutorial.body.zh:
欢迎来到灰烬回路。这里是核心机制的快速说明：

• 出牌：点击手牌后选择目标（敌人或自身）即可打出。每张牌有能量消耗，左上角显示当前能量。
• 敌人意图：敌人头顶的图标显示它下回合的行动（攻击/防御/增益等），攻击图标上的数字是伤害值。
• 护盾：受到攻击时优先扣除护盾，护盾每回合开始时清空。
• 回合结束：点击右下角「结束回合」按钮结束你的回合，敌人随后行动。未打出的手牌会被弃置。
• 目标：击败所有敌人即可获胜。生命值归零则行动失败。

地图上选择节点推进，营地可休整或升级/移除卡牌，商店可购买物资。祝你好运，博士。

victory.body.en: %s led the squad through the expedition. Whether or not you continue into the hidden floor, this run already counts as a clear.
victory.body.zh: %s带领小队完成了这次远征。无论你是否继续进入隐藏层，这一局都已经算正式通关。

victory.body_hidden.en: %s pushed through Ash Echo's final veil and carried the operation to its true end. The hidden route is now resolved and this run counts as a true ending clear.
victory.body_hidden.zh: %s穿过了灰烬回响的最后一层伪装，把这场行动真正推进到了尽头。隐藏层已经收束，这一局也被记作完整真结局通关。

victory.hint.en: From the main menu, you can still open the codex, continue, or start a new run.
victory.hint.zh: 主菜单里仍然可以继续查看百科、继续游戏或重新开局。

victory.hint_hidden.en: This run did more than clear the main route: it also resolved the hidden ending. You can keep refining builds for a cleaner true-ending path.
victory.hint_hidden.zh: 这次不只是打通了主线，还揭开了隐藏层收束。之后你可以继续优化构筑，挑战更稳的真结局路线。
